a.lede: Nvidia gets a new chief executive, days after former CEO Jensen Huang admitted to a romantic affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
a.title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang resigns, chipmaker names CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO

b.lede: Nvidia’s longtime chief financial officer helped transform the company into an AI powerhouse. Now she’s taking the reins following Jensen Huang’s resignation on Thursday.
b.title: Meet Colette Kress, Nvidia’s New Interim CEO
